blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Mayor Nestor Archival said the two-year extension of barangay officials’ terms would give those who had yet to prove their performance in public service “more time to do so.” Kenneth Siasar, Archival’s chief of staff, conveyed the mayor’s position during a press conference on Monday, Sept. 28, after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed Republic Act No. 12326, which moved the next Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) to November 2028. “At least matagaan og opportunity ang mga barangay officials nga those we feel like have not proven themselves in terms of public service, then they still have […]...
